QuestInfo.name: The Way Home
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #b#p9250122##k, who is getting a lot of attention for being clad in Chemical Protective Clothing.
QuestInfo.1: Escort #b#p9250122##k at the #b#m502010010##k to the OSSS Secret Base. \r\n\r\nTalk to #b#p9250122##k and enter the #b#m502010100##k.

0.0: Why are you staring at me like that? It's creeping me out.\r\n#L0##bAre you the researcher working for Doctor Bing? Please tell me how to get to the OSSS Secret Base.#l\n#k
0.1:
Shhh! Not so loud!
I could get abducted by aliens at any moment. Don't draw attention to me!
#L0##bI see... (Interesting choice of clothes for someone who doesn't want to be noticed.)#l
#k
0.2: Staying here will get both of us abducted, no thanks to you. I'll help you on one condition: take me with you.\r\n#L0##bFine by me. Where to?#l\n#k
0.3: I will guide you. Please board the OS3A Machine and escort me to the base.

yes.0: You do have an OSSS Machine driving license right?

no.0: You won't be able to find the OSSS Secret Base without my help.

1.0:
Welcome, welcome, to my humble abode! I am Doctor Bing! Thank you for escorting my researcher here!
#L0##bWhat is this place?#l
#L1#Geez, you should learn some telephone etiquette!#l
#k
1.1: The OSSS is a special Intelligence Organization within Omega Sector. Our mission is to collect intelligence about aliens and this is our base.\r\n#L0##bExcuse me? Intelligence about aliens? Why?#l\n#k
1.2:
You know that scientists are being kidnapped, right? General Maestro views these kidnappings as an act of aggression and is preparing for a full-scale war. Unfortunately, we can't win against the aliens with our current technology...
#L0##bThen let's flee!#l
#L1#There is ALWAYS a way...#l
#k
1.3: Yes. There is a way. We must obtain the energy source for the Bing Machine-Alpha, which I'm developing as we speak. To run, it requires a substance called Crystanol, which we theoretically won't be able to develop for another 50 years...\r\n#L0##bI'm sensing there's a twist...#l\n#k
1.4:
Indeed. If we build a Time Machine, we can travel to the future and obtain the Crystanol. Then we'll have a fully functional Bing Machine-Alpha and stand a chance against the aliens.
#L0##bI'm sensing there's another twist...#l
#L1#Fiddling with science has fiddled with your mind. A Time Machine? HA!#l
#k
1.5: No twist. We simply have to build a Time Machine. Easy enough. The researchers located in every town can lead you back to me whenever you wish.\r\nNow, do you want to help build the Time Machine?

yes.0: Come see me whenever you are ready!

0.1: Ah, but the aliens were listening in. I had no choice but to behave that way. I do apologize if I seemed brash.

2.0: Flee? Ha! To where? Outer space? Do you see the irony in that?

4.1: Ah, the youths of today have so little imagination. Great things are possible if you only believe...
